Design authority: docs/delivery/workspace-design.md, sections 8.3; courts I/J. Visual references: mockups/workspace-vision-2026-09-22/README.md.
Repository owner: storyatlas4s. Delivery boundary: M1 implementation.
Integration parent: bd-01M34JJ77XECH5T7J2K1ZKGFV8; parent relationship does not itself block execution.
Entry dependencies: bd-01M35A7BPV353CV9JY3472S65G.

REUSE, SCOPE AND PRESERVATION
Own export dialog, edition/CLI orchestration and independent readback witness. Reuse publication and provider subset queries; bind selected scope, scientific result/cut/grain/support/decisions and permitted content in a receipt. Keep broader no-JavaScript portable bundle separate.

ACCEPTANCE AND FAILURE WITNESSES
1. Figure, accessible twin and exact permitted subset identify the same selected rows/targets/run; independent Python or Scala reader recovers expected values/support.
2. Wrong policy, cropped-row normalization, rounded authoritative coordinate and denied-string injections fail.
3. Pinned publication determinism remains separately tested from responsive live geometry; receipt identifies exact producer/consumer/artifact and layout basis.

EVIDENCE
Record exact producer/consumer/dependency revisions, fixture digests, actual commands/results and warnings/skips. Apply design section 11.5 and AGENTS.md to the changed runtime boundary, including compileAll testAll scalafmtCheckAll app/fastLinkJS and relevant existing/new browser courts for shell changes; use isolated siblings and session-owned project browsers. Documentation-only or human-study evidence is scoped as such. New test names are specifications until implemented and run. No inference, calibration, hosted CI, publication or release is certified by ticket creation.

FALLBACK
Retain existing publication routes; fail unsupported export rather than scraping SVG or substituting values.

Coordinate one implementation writer and one heavy build at a time. Reserve exact paths when taking the ticket; do not claim other writers' scopes. Keep scientific operations in StoryModel, reuse this application and preserve unrelated edits.
set.title: [M1] Export the same selected record through figure, twin and subset
